reviews.text: It was fine. Fortunately, there was no treatment.

He is a great example of humanity. Our dog couldn't stand up, we took him to Primavet, they did an X-ray, and they determined that his left hind knee was slightly inflamed and he had dysplasia. We left a nice little amount there for an X-ray. They prescribed anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving medications. At first everything was fine, he was slowly able to stand up, although he limped, he received the prescribed dose of medication with food, never on an empty stomach. Then one day he stopped eating and vomited everything, and from then on he didn't receive any more medication. The next morning he tried to stand up, but collapsed at the door. We quickly took him to Primavet again, but unfortunately the dog didn't survive the trip, he put his last box down 10 minutes before arrival, but we still had hope that they could save him. We got there, they took him in immediately, and then fifteen minutes later they told us that they couldn't save him, but they charged 5,000 HUF for the medicine they had given to the dead dog, which was truly humane behavior. An animal doesn't die because of a little knee pain and hip pain. It's quite likely that he was prescribed the wrong amount of the wrong medicine, and that's why he can't be with us anymore. (Primavet, Budapest Rákosi út 60.)
They have very well-prepared doctors. They are very kind.
We lost our second pet to them within a few years.
We always received professional care, with very good information and suggestions.

Both of my French bulldogs were successfully operated on here, the first one by Dr. Zsoldos, the dog was 5 years old at the time of the spinal surgery, he passed away at 15, he also hiked with me in his last years. My second French bulldog was operated on by Dr. Benda 1 week ago for a cervical hernia, the dog has been living pain-free since the day after the surgery, although this whole matter put a great mental burden on the family, I trusted in a positive outcome and it did.

I do not recommend this to anyone!
A crooked, money-hungry company. They do not give me an invoice for the hundred thousand forints I paid and they cannot tell me what is wrong with my cat. They do not deserve even one star.

There was no free appointment for the day when I called..the lady on the phone was very helpful and said if I got there on time the doctor would still see me. I got there..The doctor Koncseg was very kind and examined the dog thoroughly. Thank you very much.
This is my second time here. I took my Shiba Inu dog for knee surgery. I am very satisfied with the clinic.

Dr. Zsófi Kántás is the best veterinarian! We have been going to her for over 7 years
I recommend her wholeheartedly to everyone!

We would like to thank Dr. András Bánfi for repairing Maya's left hind leg with TPLO surgery. Poor dog had five surgeries on both hind legs in another place, which were unsuccessful😢
Then we visited Dr. András Bánfi, who operated on Maya.
After the surgery, we went for physiotherapy treatment, which helped a lot. Gabriella Ebyliti Fizióterapía Versitz in Újpest. A huge thank you for that!
Three months have passed and the dog's leg has already healed according to the X-ray. He uses it nicely, as if nothing had happened.
Unfortunately, his right hind leg, which was operated on elsewhere, also had to be operated on again. Dr. Bánfi also repaired this leg, performing TPLO surgery. It went very well. Poor dog is now through his seventh surgery, although 2 surgeries would have been enough if Dr. Bánfi had performed it.
We are very grateful and a huge thank you for your conscientious work. It seems that for him this is not a job, but a vocation.
Thank you very much!

Thank you very much for the quick, kind and professional help you provided to my 1-year-old Labrador puppy shortly before closing time, when they removed a piece of wood lodged in his palate. I would wholeheartedly recommend the practice to anyone.
My gratitude and thanks to Andrea Hámori for her brilliant and conscientious work today! My dog ​​sniffed out a tick, and the Doctor cured it without expensive intervention.

We brought our dog here with suspicion of mange, luckily we got away with an ear wash. 37,000+16,000 for an ear wash liquid+drops.
I don't feel sorry for my dog, but the shameless unethical removal is not an elegant thing.

Due to a sudden leg pain in our dog, we urgently and with great concern visited Dr. Dávid Benda.
Everyone at the reception was also direct and empathetic.
The professional and human attitude of the Doctor was exemplary!
Due to his reassuring, kind personality and easy-to-understand explanations, all our worries disappeared.
We are very, very grateful to him and all his employees!
Macesz owners

Dr. Bánfi performed an extremely successful TPLO surgery on our 63 kg Great Dane, Merlin, for a torn cruciate ligament. Since then, Merlin has been running happily again and living a full life!

And half a year later, he practically saved his life from afar: based on an X-ray taken abroad – for which we did not receive a clear diagnosis locally – he recognized the suspicion of intestinal torsion and advised us to go to the emergency room immediately. His suspicion was confirmed, Merlin underwent urgent surgery, and fortunately, his life was saved in time.

We are extremely grateful to Dr. Bánfi for his expertise, conscientiousness and selfless help. We recommend him wholeheartedly!
